## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Use Case / Motivation

Describe the problem or use case that this feature would address. Why is this feature valuable to you or other users?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of how you'd like this feature to be implemented.

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered and why they were not suitable.

## Difficulty

How would you rate the difficulty of implementing this feature?

- [ ] Easy — Minor change, straightforward implementation
- [ ] Medium — Requires some research or moderate code changes
- [ ] Hard — Significant architectural changes or complex implementation

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.
